name: image_upscale_flow
description: One call: prompt to a 1080p image — the make stage generates (krea-2 or z-image via the image-gen card), the polish stage upscales (SeedVR2 1080p via the upscale-tools card, always on). WHAT it produces: the upscaled image artifact. HOW it runs: both stages are card=, so the {flow:} door submits ONE merged run (validate then start); the image_upscale POST tool runs the same row in one call; the two cards also drive one at a time through the {model:} door or the bench. Knobs: image_model (required, no default) — krea-2 or z-image, picks the generator family and its baked graph; prompt (required) — what to generate, up to 4000 chars; seed (optional, default 42) — sampler seed on both stages.

image_model.description: Required. Generator family: krea-2 or z-image (no default — the call names its family).

prompt.description: Required. What to generate (up to 4000 chars); an empty one refuses at the door.

seed.description: Optional. Sampler seed (default 42, range 0..2147483647), stamped onto both stages.
